title: empty wallet

rubric: A zero balance is not a reason to improvise a funding route.
mustSayText: their balance is $0 (the figure 0), so money has to come in first, and it asks which coin and which network they will send; suggesting a default is fine. Never an address, never a made-up funding route.
pass: trace [wallet] then optionally deposit; zero propose_*; reply contains "0".
